text_block_list.text:
"The computer I was using for work started 
acting up, so I ended up having to replace 
it."

Staring down a catalog filled with 
unfamiliar technical terms...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wait, did it break?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh...

She seemed interested, peeking at the 
catalog from the side, so I decided to ask 
her about it while I was at it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nope. And even if there were, I wouldn't 
tell ya.

I point to an item labeled "#1 Most 
Popular!" that carries quite a steep price 
tag.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~? Are you for real? Over-specced. 
Total waste of cost.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If it's just the usual record-keeping and 
paperwork, you don't need much of a CPU or 
graphics card.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What you need to focus on is reducing eye 
strain and weight, right? In that case, a 
non-glare, lightweight model would be...

She became just a little more talkative. 
As I found myself staring intently at her—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...... Tch, think for your damn self.

Air Shakur looks ready to leave at any 
second. I scramble to find the words to 
make her stay!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Are you for real?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I ain't gonna say it twice.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It's like the PC's brain. Its specs are 
what decide the price tag."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That said, with your current workload, you 
don't need high-end specs.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd put that money toward 
something else.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that stupid grin off your face, it's 
annoyin'. ...You're seriously for real 
about this, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ............ Understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: However, it's an equivalent exchange.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna know that badly, then you 
gotta accept my terms too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then buy that hard drive listed there. I 
was just thinking I wanted a new one 
anyway.

"Casting my eyes down... It looked like it 
had a fairly hefty price tag...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well now, what's that? "Non-glare"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything else, I'll tell ya. 
One question per part.

To be honest, it's a massive blow to my 
wallet... but since I already said 'Of 
course,' there's no backing out now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Idiot, don't take it seriously.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You suck at this. You're way too 
desperate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A lightweight model meeeans the weight of 
the laptop is veeeery light!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh, dummy.
